back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face toward the south, preach against the south, and prophesy against the forest in the region of the Negev.

Say to the forest of the Negev: Hear the word of the LORD! The Lord GOD says this: Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree and every dry tree in you; the blazing flame will not be quenched, and every face from the south to the north will be scorched by it.
Then all people will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it, and it will not be quenched.”
Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD, they are saying of me, ‘Is he not just a speaker of parables?’”
Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, preach against the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
Say to the land of Israel, the LORD says this: Behold, I am against you; I will draw My sword from its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.
Because I will cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked, My sword will go out from its sheath against all people from the south to the north.
Then all people will know that I, the LORD, have drawn My sword from its sheath; it will not return to its sheath again.
As for you, son of man, groan! Groan before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.

When they ask you, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you are to answer, ‘Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt, every hand will go limp, every spirit will faint, and every knee will be as weak as water.’ Behold, it is coming and it will surely happen, the Lord GOD says this.”
Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, prophesy and say, the Lord says this: Say, ‘A sword, a sword, sharpened and also polished—
the sword is sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning. Can we rejoice in the scepter of My son, when the sword despises every such stick?
The sword is given to be polished, to be grasped in the hand; it is sharpened and polished, to be placed in the hand of the slayer.

Son of man, cry out and wail, for the sword will strike My people, it will strike all the princes of Israel. They are handed over to the sword together with My people; therefore strike your thigh in grief.
For testing will surely come; and what then, if even the scepter that the sword despises does not endure? the Lord GOD says this.’
As for you, son of man, prophesy and clap your hands together. Let the sword strike down two times, three times; it is a sword of slaughter, a sword of great massacre that closes in on every side.
So that their hearts may melt and many may stumble and fall, I have set a slaughtering sword at all their city gates. Alas, the sword is made to flash like lightning; it is drawn for the slaughter.
O sword, strike to the right, turn to the left; strike wherever your edge is directed.
I Myself will also clap My hands together, and I will satisfy My wrath. I, the LORD, have spoken.”
Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

“As for you, son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to come; both roads come out from the same land. And make a signpost at the head of the road that branches off to each city.
Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites, and another against Judah at fortified Jerusalem.
For the king of Babylon stands at the fork, at the head of the two roads, to seek an omen: he shakes the arrows, consults the household idols, and examines the liver.

The result of the divination in his right hand points to Jerusalem: to set up battering rams, to give the command for slaughter, to raise a war cry, to set battering rams against the city gates, to throw up a siege ramp, and to build a siege wall.

But to the people of Jerusalem who had sworn an oath of alliance with the king of Babylon, the divination seems like a false omen in their eyes; yet the king will bring to remembrance their guilt, and take them captive.

Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Because you have brought your guilt to remembrance, with your transgressions exposed, so that your sins appear in all your deeds—because you are remembered like this—you will be seized by the hand.
And you, O wicked and profaned prince of Israel, your day has come, the time of the final punishment for your guilt.
The Lord GOD says this: Take off the turban, remove the crown. Things will not remain as they are: lift up the lowly, and bring down the exalted.
A ruin, a ruin, I will make it a ruin! It will not remain again, until the one who has the rightful claim comes—the one to whom I have given that right.”

As for you, son of man, prophesy and say, the Lord GOD says this concerning the Ammonites and their mockery: Say, ‘A sword, a sword is drawn for slaughter, polished to consume and destroy, to flash like lightning—
while they see false visions about you and prophesy lies for you, the sword will be laid on the necks of the wicked who are slain, whose day has come, the time of the final punishment.
Put the sword back into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.
I will pour out My anger upon you; I will breathe the fire of My fury against you, and hand you over to brutal men, skilled in destruction.
You will be fuel for the fire; your blood will flow in the midst of the land; you will no longer be remembered, for I, the LORD, have spoken.”
